Test Case Description: Vet uploads valid JPG avatar and profile saves
Test Case Procedure: 1. Login as Veterinarian. 2. Open My Profile > Edit Profile. 3. Choose a JPG file under 2MB via camera button. 4. Save Changes.
Expected Results: Profile redirects with success; Users.profile_picture_url is /uploads/avatars/vet-{userId}-{timestamp}.jpg; avatar shows on profile with new image.

Test Case Description: Upload PNG / GIF / WebP for any role using edit-profile
Test Case Procedure: 1. Login (Customer or Admin or Lab or Receptionist). 2. Edit Profile. 3. Select PNG (or GIF/WebP) under 2MB. 4. Save.
Expected Results: File stored; DB path updated; image visible on profile and header (if applicable).

Test Case Description: Reject upload when file exceeds max size
Test Case Procedure: 1. Edit Profile. 2. Select image > 2MB. 3. Save.
Expected Results: Error or upload rejected; DB profile_picture_url unchanged (or no new file).

Test Case Procedure: 1. Edit Profile. 2. Upload non-image or unsupported type. 3. Save.

Test Case Description: Save profile text without choosing new photo
Test Case Procedure: 1. Edit Profile. 2. Change name/phone/address only; do not touch file input. 3. Save.
Expected Results: Fields update; profile_picture_url unchanged; no orphan requirement.

Test Case Description: New upload replaces previous file (timestamp filename)
